# CANDIDATE: EARLY_START_FILTER_AND_MIN_TRIGGERS

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the catastrophe premium stop from -50% to -20% and delaying entry until after 09:35 ET reduces losses on choppy morning reversals while maintaining capture of strong directional moves. Requiring only one trigger (vs. baseline's higher threshold) increases participation in valid setups without degrading edge, as confirmed by the grinder's top keeper showing improved consistency on J loser days (5/05, 5/06) and selective participation on 5/07.

## Mechanism

- **Entry trigger:** Requires at least 1 bearish trigger (min_triggers_bear=1) after 09:35 ET (no_trade_before="09:35")  
- **Exit logic:**  
  - Catastrophe premium stop: -20% of entry premium (premium_stop_pct_bear=-0.2)  
  - Profit-lock: Arms at +5% profit (profit_lock_threshold_pct=0.05), then trails stop to entry premium + 10% of entry premium (profit_lock_stop_offset_pct=0.1)  
  - TP1: Sell 50% of position at +30% profit (tp1_premium_pct=0.3, tp1_qty_fraction=0.5)  
  - Runner: Target +250% profit (runner_target_premium_pct=2.5)  
- **Strike:** ATM put (strike_offset_bear=0)
